Description: 2×20 2.54mm female THT pin socket — daughter board ↔ Waveshare ESP32-P4-POE-ETH (SKU 32088) interface
5V→12V fixed-12V boost converter, TO-220-5, 1.5A — powers fan +12V rail
100µH axial THT inductor, 0.8A — boost converter catch inductor
40V 5A Schottky SMD — boost converter catch diode
10kΩ 0402 1% — fan TACH pull-up resistors (3.3V from J8)
Red 0805 SMD LED — per-fan power indicator (lights when +12V on fan header)
Green 3mm THT LED, 565nm — GPIO status indicator
